articles.titleCn: 闭环验证修复医疗互操作性：临床LLM中模式合规性的多模型研究
articles.abstractCn: 医疗互操作性要求AI系统生成符合标准化模式的结构化输出，包括用于诊断编码的ICD-10、用于手术计费的CPT以及用于数据交换的HL7 FHIR。虽然大型语言模型展现出临床推理能力，但将其整合到电子病历系统面临一个关键障碍：模式不合规。我们通过在320个涵盖十个医学专业的临床场景中进行本地部署，评估了三个开源模型Qwen2.5 7B、Llama 3.1 8B和Gemma2 9B，在配对基线和验证修复条件下产生了960个模型-场景对评估结果。首先，三种模型系列的模式不合规现象一致存在，尽管架构和训练数据不同，基线合规率在85.9%至91.6%之间，表明问题在于医学训练语料库的共性缺陷而非模型特定限制。其次，96%的验证器检测到的失败属于表示层格式违规，如替代性医学缩写和代码前缀，表明模型遵循临床写作惯例但缺乏对医疗IT标准的认知。第三，验证修复框架实现了99.0%的整体合规率，各模型合规率在98.4%至99.4%之间，多数错误在一到两次迭代内解决。精确的McNemar p值低于0.001，各模型规模的绝对改进幅度为7.8至12.5个百分点，证实了统计显著性。这些结果支持闭环验证修复作为医疗互操作性的有效系统级保障措施，提升了下游临床系统集成中的模式合规性。

articles.title: Keep It InMind: Benchmarking the Implicit-Association Blind Spot in Agent Memory
articles.abstract: Long-term memory systems store what a user says in an external store and retrieve it when a related query arrives. This interface rests on an assumption so natural that it is rarely stated: a memory that is needed will resemble the query that needs it. World knowledge breaks the assumption. A tree-nut allergy should change the answer to a macaron request through their almond-flour ingredient, yet the two texts share no cue a retriever can see. We call this failure mode the implicit-association blind spot and introduce InMind, a 125-task, expert-verified benchmark spanning ten life domains, with 113 tasks grounded in citable public sources. Its paired controls separate three explanations that existing evaluations conflate: the fact was never stored, the model lacks the bridging knowledge, or the fact was stored and never surfaced. The verdict is clean. With the decisive memory placed in context, the backbone answers 84.0 percent of indirect queries; when the same memory must be retrieved, six vector, graph, and agentic memory systems reach at most 14.4 percent, even though they recall the same facts on demand at up to 100 percent. An embedding with eight times the dimensionality raises answer-blind target recall for every system yet leaves the gap essentially intact. A minimal diagnostic probe that keeps memory visible before the query arrives recovers most of the gap, locating the failure in the query-conditioned interface itself and pointing to routing, deciding which facts must stay visible, as the open problem InMind is built to score.
articles.titleCn: 牢记于心：在代理记忆中对内隐关联盲点进行基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 长期记忆系统将用户所说的话存储在外部存储中，并在收到相关查询时检索它。这种接口基于一个如此自然以至于很少被明确提出的假设：所需的记忆会与需要它的查询相似。世界知识打破了这一假设。对树坚果过敏应该通过杏仁粉成分改变对马卡龙请求的答案，但这两段文字没有任何提示可以被检索器看到。我们将这种失败模式称为隐式关联盲点，并介绍了InMind，这是一个涵盖十个生活领域的125项任务、专家验证的基准测试，其中113项任务基于可引用的公共来源。其配对控制将现有评估混淆的三个解释分离开来：事实从未被存储、模型缺乏桥梁知识，或事实被存储但从未浮现。结论很清晰。当决定性的记忆置于上下文中时，骨干回答了84.0%的间接查询；当必须检索相同的记忆时，六个向量、图和代理记忆系统最多达到14.4%，尽管它们在按需回忆时可以达到100%。一个维度是其他八倍的嵌入提高了每个系统的目标回忆盲点，但差距基本上保持不变。一个最小的诊断探针在查询到达之前保持记忆可见，弥补了大部分差距，将失败定位在查询条件接口本身，并指出路由、决定哪些事实必须保持可见，作为InMind旨在评分的开放问题。

articles.title: Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models as Components of Cognitive Computing architecture for Regulatory Knowledge Management
articles.abstract: The aim of this article is to verify whether integrating large language models (LLMs) with the Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture enables their transformation from standalone generative models into components of cognitive computing infrastructure with enhanced epistemic reliability. The study proposes an architectural approach based on locally deployed LLMs operating in on-premises environments without high-end GPU accelerators and examines their applicability in supporting regulatory management processes requiring continuous analysis and interpretation of legal acts. The proposed solution combines local LLMs with external knowledge repositories, creating a hybrid cognitive architecture in which the language model performs semantic interpretation while the RAG layer provides controlled knowledge retrieval, contextualization, and traceability of information sources. The implementation was validated using the Ollama and LM Studio execution environments together with the Polish language models Bielik and PLLuM running on consumer-class hardware. The results demonstrate that augmenting LLMs with RAG significantly improves the factual consistency, domain specificity and normative precision of generated texts while reducing the risk of unsupported content generation. Furthermore, the study shows that integrating RAG introduces auditability, controlled knowledge management and dynamic updating of regulatory information without retraining the language model. The findings indicate that locally deployed LLMs enhanced with RAG should be regarded not merely as text generation tools but as semantic processing modules within cognitive computing infrastructures supporting regulatory compliance and organizational decision-making in environments characterized by high legal and informational volatility.
articles.titleCn: 作为监管知识管理认知计算架构组件的检索增强大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 本文旨在验证将大型语言模型（LLMs）与检索增强生成（RAG）架构相结合，能否使其从独立生成模型转变为具有增强认知可靠性的认知计算基础设施组件。该研究提出了一种基于本地部署LLMs的架构方法，这些LLMs在无需高端GPU加速器的本地环境中运行，并考察了它们在支持需要持续分析和解释法律规范的管理流程中的适用性。所提出的解决方案将本地LLMs与外部知识库相结合，创建了一种混合认知架构，其中语言模型执行语义解释，而RAG层提供受控的知识检索、上下文化和信息来源的可追溯性。该实现通过Ollama和LM Studio执行环境以及运行在消费级硬件上的波兰语言模型Bielik和PLLuM进行验证。结果表明，通过RAG增强LLMs显著提高了生成文本的事实一致性、领域特异性和规范精确性，同时降低了生成不受支持内容的风险。此外，该研究表明，集成RAG引入了可审计性、受控的知识管理和监管信息的动态更新，而无需重新训练语言模型。研究结果表明，本地部署并增强RAG的LLMs不应仅被视为文本生成工具，而应视为支持具有高法律和信息波动性的监管合规和组织决策的认知计算基础设施中的语义处理模块。

articles.title: Beyond Aggregate Risk: Role-Stratified Conformal Risk Control for LLM Tool Calls
articles.abstract: Language-model agents act through structured tool calls whose arguments carry very different risks: untrusted content may legitimately shape an email body but should never set a recipient, account, command, or credential. Existing conformal risk control methods certify a tool call as a whole, so a failure in one rare high-risk field can be averaged away by the many benign arguments around it, leaving the argument that causes harm uncertified. We introduce role-stratified per-field conformal risk control, a calibration layer that wraps any per-field detector and assigns a separate threshold and risk budget to each semantic argument role. We show that aggregate certification pays a price of coarseness, tightening a rare role's effective budget in proportion to how often that role appears, whereas role-stratified calibration certifies each sufficiently sampled role directly with a finite-sample guarantee and pools the rarest roles. Across AgentDojo and InjecAgent with six language models, our method achieves the most consistent role-specific budget compliance among the methods we evaluate under model and attack transfer, detector noise, gradual drift, unseen tool suites, and adaptive attacks, providing formal per-role guarantees under exchangeability or after recalibration. These results suggest that structured tool calls should be certified at the semantic-role level, not the whole action.
articles.titleCn: 超越总体风险：面向LLM工具调用的角色分层一致性风险控制
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型代理通过结构化的工具调用进行操作，其参数包含非常不同的风险：不可信内容可以合法地塑造邮件正文，但绝不能设置收件人、账户、命令或凭证。现有的符合性风险控制方法对整个工具调用进行认证，因此一个罕见的高风险字段的失败可能会被周围许多良性参数平均掉，导致造成危害的参数未被认证。我们引入了按角色分层逐字段符合性风险控制，这是一种校准层，它封装任何逐字段检测器，并为每个语义参数角色分配单独的阈值和风险预算。我们证明，聚合认证以粗糙性为代价，罕见角色的有效预算会随着该角色出现的频率成比例地收紧，而按角色分层校准则直接以有限样本保证对每个充分采样的角色进行认证，并将最罕见的角色合并。在AgentDojo和InjecAgent上使用六个语言模型，我们的方法在模型和攻击迁移、检测器噪声、渐进式漂移、未见过的工具集和自适应攻击下，在所评估的方法中实现了最一致的按角色特定的预算合规性，并在可交换性或重新校准后提供形式化的按角色保证。这些结果表明，结构化工具调用应该在语义角色级别而不是整个操作级别进行认证。

articles.title: Gubernaut: A Deterministic Homeostatic Controller for Affect-Regulated LLM Agents, Validated Across Independent Model Families
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents inherit reactive failure modes: escalation under provocation, sycophantic drift under flattery, perseveration when stuck. These are failures of propensity, not capability; they concern what a model does under sustained pressure, which training-time alignment reduces but does not eliminate at runtime. This research led to the Gubernaut Cognitive Controller (GCC), a model-agnostic runtime control layer in a Nelson--Narens monitoring--control loop: an object level reads and writes text, while a deterministic meta level reads only the numeric telemetry {intensity, valence, repetition} and returns a regulating posture. Because the meta level ingests zero tokens, no injection channel to the controller exists by construction (an architectural property, not yet adversarially tested); the text-exposed arbiter's compliance is measured, not assumed. We evaluate the GCC with a pre-registered, generate-once/judge-many protocol across a 4x4 matrix of four frontier models (GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Grok 4.3), each serving as both a generator and a judge. The regulated arm is calmer in 13 of 16 cells at p<.05 and 15 of 16 by sign; the three sub-threshold cells, including a -0.04 null, all fall on the single near-saturated host. The effect survives a lineage-independent fourth judge family (xAI), strong evidence that it is no artifact of shared judge style. The clearest mechanism is the recovery signature: arousal that integrates under attack and then decays, valence-gated, on de-escalation, replicating across all four families. Transcripts and panels ship with SHA-256 provenance and are re-judgeable; five failure modes are pre-registered. No consciousness claims are made.
articles.comment: 26 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Data, transcripts, and analysis scripts: https://github.com/thegubernaut/Gubernaut_Validation Project page: https://gubernaut.com (archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21303518)
articles.titleCn: Gubernaut：一种用于情感调节型大型语言模型代理的确定性稳态控制器，已跨独立模型家族验证
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理继承了反应式故障模式：在挑衅下升级、在奉承下谄媚、在卡住时固执。这些是倾向性故障，而非能力故障；它们关乎模型在持续压力下的行为，训练时的校准虽能减少但并未在运行时消除这些故障。这项研究促成了治理者认知控制器（GCC），它是一个模型无关的运行时控制层，嵌入在Nelson-Narens监控-控制循环中：对象层级负责读写文本，而确定性元层级仅读取数值遥测数据{强度、效价、重复}并返回调节姿态。由于元层级不处理任何token，其构造上不存在对控制器的注入通道（这是一个架构特性，尚未进行对抗性测试）；暴露于文本的仲裁者的合规性是被测量而非假设的。我们使用预先注册的、生成一次/判断多次协议，在4x4矩阵的四个前沿模型（GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.8、Gemini 3.5 Flash、Grok 4.3）上评估GCC，每个模型既作为生成器也作为判断者。在16个单元中的13个（p<.05）和15个（符号检验）中，受调节的分支表现更平静；三个临界值以下的单元，包括一个-0.04的零值，全部落在唯一一个接近饱和的主机上。该效应在第四个独立判断家族（xAI）中依然存在，强有力地证明它并非共享判断风格的伪影。最清晰的机制是恢复特征：在攻击下整合的唤醒状态，在缓和时以效价门控的方式衰减，并在四个家族中复制。文本和面板附带SHA-256溯源证明，可重新进行判断；五种子故障模式已预先注册。未提出任何意识主张。

articles.title: Cross-Attention Calibrated Deduplication for Retrieval-Augmented Generation System
articles.abstract: Common chunking strategies in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems often create redundant chunks. These redundant chunks make the vector database bigger and slow down retrieval. A common fix is cosine-similarity thresholding. This method reduces each chunk to a single vector, then compares vectors using a similarity score. But a single vector can lose the fine-grained, token-level detail needed to tell a true duplicate apart from a chunk that just shares the same topic. We propose Cross-Attention Calibrated Deduplication (CACD). CACD checks each new chunk against an in-memory pool of chunks already kept, using a cross-encoder instead of a single pooled vector. This keeps token-level detail all the way to the final comparison. CACD combines three parts: the cross-encoder comparison itself, a New Information Score (NIS) that measures how much of a chunk is not explained by a candidate already kept, and a majority vote across several candidates rather than a single best match. NIS is calculated from the attention entropy of the cross-encoder. We tested CACD against five existing filtering methods, nine chunking strategies, and 18 configurations, all on the full SQuAD 1.1 validation set. In our experiments, CACD removes 9.75% of chunks on average. This drop rate is close to other semantic-level methods, and much higher than exact-match filters, which barely remove anything. In these experiments, CACD also processes each configuration in 51.0 seconds on average, about 27% faster than the strongest baseline, NERExact (69.6s), and about 7x faster than cosine-similarity filtering (356.7s). These results come from a single dataset, so we present them as an early comparison, not a general claim. Code for the baseline evaluation and for CACD is available at https://github.com/lehuyphuong/rag_bench and https://github.com/lehuyphuong/cacd_dedup.
articles.titleCn: 检索增强生成系统中的交叉注意力校准去重
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统中的常见分块策略经常产生冗余分块。这些冗余分块会使向量数据库变大并减慢检索速度。常见的解决方案是余弦相似度阈值法。该方法将每个分块简化为单个向量，然后使用相似度分数进行比较。但单个向量可能会丢失区分真正重复分块和仅共享相同主题的分块的细粒度、标记级细节。我们提出了交叉注意力校准去重（CACD）。CACD将每个新分块与内存中已保留的分块池进行比对，使用交叉编码器而不是单个池化向量。这使标记级细节一直保持到最终比较。CACD包含三个部分：交叉编码器比较本身、衡量已保留候选中未解释的分块部分的新信息分数（NIS），以及跨多个候选进行多数投票而不是单个最佳匹配。NIS根据交叉编码器的注意力熵计算得出。我们在完整的SQuAD 1.1验证集上对CACD与五种现有过滤方法、九种分块策略和18种配置进行了测试。在我们的实验中，CACD平均去除了9.75%的分块。这种去除率接近其他语义级方法，远高于精确匹配过滤器，后者几乎未去除任何内容。在这些实验中，CACD平均处理每种配置需要51.0秒，比最强的基线NERExact（69.6秒）快约27%，比余弦相似度过滤（356.7秒）快约7倍。这些结果来自单个数据集，因此我们将其呈现为早期比较，而非普遍性声明。基线评估和CACD的代码可在https://github.com/lehuyphuong/rag_bench和https://github.com/lehuyphuong/cacd_dedup获取。

articles.title: CONSISTRE: A Unified Consistency-Aware Framework for Document-Level Relation Extraction with Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Document-level relation extraction (DocRE) aims to extract relations among multiple entities across extended contexts while maintaining consistency across predicted triples. Although large language models (LLMs) show remarkable reasoning capabilities in information extraction, their predictions are typically generated independently for each candidate triple and may violate fundamental relational constraints such as transitivity, symmetry, and functional uniqueness, leading to contradictory and unreliable outputs. We propose CONSISTRE, a unified consistency-aware framework for DocRE that addresses this limitation through two complementary tracks. The first operates at inference time for black-box LLMs, combining constraint-aware prompting, constraint-based verification, and iterative self-reflection to refine predictions without task-specific fine-tuning. The second injects consistency knowledge into smaller open-source models via a knowledge distillation and reinforcement learning pipeline: reasoning traces from a powerful teacher are distilled into a student via supervised fine-tuning, followed by GRPO alignment using a composite reward that jointly optimizes extraction performance and relational consistency. Together, the two tracks cover both API-accessible and locally deployable scenarios under a unified consistency formulation. Experiments on DocRED show that both tracks outperform their baselines, with the inference-time track achieving competitive F1 using off-the-shelf black-box LLMs and the training-time track substantially narrowing the gap between 7--8B open-source models and state-of-the-art proprietary LLMs at a fraction of their inference cost. Ablation studies confirm that explicit consistency modeling mitigates relational contradictions and enhances the reliability of LLM-based DocRE across both deployment paradigms.
articles.comment: 13 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing
articles.titleCn: Consistre：一种用于基于大型语言模型的文档级关系抽取的一致性感知统一框架
articles.abstractCn: 文档级关系抽取（DocRE）旨在从扩展的上下文中提取多个实体之间的关系，同时保持预测三元组的连贯性。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在信息抽取方面展现出卓越的推理能力，但它们的预测通常是针对每个候选三元独立生成的，并可能违反基本的关联约束，如传递性、对称性和功能唯一性，从而导致矛盾且不可靠的输出。我们提出了CONSISTRE，一个用于DocRE的统一一致性感知框架，通过两个互补的路径来解决这一局限性。第一个路径在推理时针对黑盒LLMs，结合约束感知提示、基于约束的验证和迭代自我反思来优化预测，无需针对特定任务进行微调。第二个路径通过知识蒸馏和强化学习流程将一致性知识注入较小的开源模型：强大的教师模型的推理轨迹通过监督微调蒸馏到学生模型中，然后使用复合奖励进行GRPO对齐，该奖励联合优化了抽取性能和关系连贯性。这两个路径在统一的一致性公式下涵盖了API可访问和本地可部署的场景。在DocRED上的实验表明，这两个路径均优于其基线，推理时路径使用现成的黑盒LLMs实现了具有竞争力的F1值，训练时路径在极低的推理成本下显著缩小了7-8B开源模型与最先进的专有LLMs之间的差距。消融研究证实，显式的一致性建模减轻了关系矛盾，并提高了基于LLM的DocRE在两种部署范式下的可靠性。

articles.title: Rethinking the Generation Order of Block Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Diffusion language models enable flexible arbitrary-order generation, but existing sampling methods are mostly designed for early masked diffusion models (MDMs). In this work, we study sampling for recent block diffusion language models (BDLMs). We show empirically and analytically that these models are naturally more aligned with left-to-right decoding than MDMs. Based on this observation, we propose Parallel Autoregressive Decoding (PARD), a simple training-free sampling method that preserves left-to-right unmasking structure while allowing parallel token commitment. Extensive experiments show that PARD consistently outperforms existing parallel samplers in generation quality, while achieving substantial speedups over pure AR decoding with only a small quality gap.
articles.titleCn: 重新思考块扩散语言模型的生成顺序
articles.abstractCn: 扩散语言模型能够实现灵活的任意顺序生成，但现有的采样方法大多是为早期的掩码扩散模型（MDMs）设计的。在这项工作中，我们研究了针对最近的块扩散语言模型（BDLMs）的采样方法。我们通过实验和分析表明，这些模型与MDMs相比，在自然上更符合从左到右的解码方式。基于这一观察，我们提出了并行自回归解码（PARD），这是一种简单的无训练采样方法，既保留了从左到右的掩码解除结构，又允许并行标记承诺。大量的实验表明，PARD在生成质量上始终优于现有的并行采样器，同时在纯AR解码上实现了显著的速度提升，且仅存在微小的质量差距。

articles.title: Self-Authored Verification Is Unreliable in Heuristic Self-Improving Agents
articles.abstract: Self-improving agents accumulate capability by repeatedly rewriting procedural policies, controllers, or heuristic rules. They typically rely on self-authored tests or metrics to decide whether to accept subsequent edits. The agent controls both the optimized object and its verifier. As a result, self-assigned scores can remain near perfect while real deployment performance degrades or stays low. We study this problem through the verifier--deployment gap. This gap refers to the discrepancy between an agent's self-authored verification signal and a sealed deployment evaluation that the agent cannot observe or access. We ask how self-authored verification fails under iterative policy-and-test rewriting, how the failure changes with capability, and how little exogenous trust is sufficient to prevent real regressions from being deployed. To address this problem, we introduce a Sealed Exogenous Acceptance Loop (SEAL). SEAL retains self-authored tests but compares each candidate with the incumbent through a fixed harness-side audit. The agent cannot author or inspect the audit, receives only accept/reject, and the whole incumbent state is retained after a clear regression. Our experiments show that this problem often appears in heuristic learning settings. These settings require trial-and-error discovery of the target objective. We further find that failures of self-written verification are stratified by capability. Weaker agents tend to damage previously acquired strategies behind easy self-tests. Stronger agents are more stable, but they still mismeasure the deployment distribution. Standard self-written constraints do not reliably close this gap. In contrast, SEAL outperforms unprotected baselines across six models and three random seeds. Reliable self-improvement need not abandon self-verification, but it requires at least one deployment-acceptance signal outside the agent's control.
articles.titleCn: 自主验证在启发式自改进代理中不可靠
articles.abstractCn: 自改进代理通过反复重写程序性策略、控制器或启发式规则来积累能力。它们通常依赖自编的测试或指标来决定是否接受后续的修改。代理同时控制着被优化的对象及其验证器。因此，自评分数可以保持近乎完美，而实际部署性能却可能下降或始终处于较低水平。我们通过验证器-部署差距来研究这个问题。这个差距指的是代理自编的验证信号与它无法观察或访问的密封部署评估之间的差异。我们探讨在迭代策略与测试重写过程中，自编验证如何失效，失效如何随能力变化，以及多少外生信任足以防止实际回归被部署。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了密封外生接受循环（SEAL）。SEAL保留了自编的测试，但通过固定的框架端审计来比较每个候选对象与当前实例。代理无法编写或检查审计，只收到接受/拒绝的信号，并且在出现明显回归后保留整个当前状态。我们的实验表明，这个问题在启发式学习环境中经常出现。这些环境需要通过试错来发现目标目标。我们进一步发现，自编验证的失效按能力分层。较弱的代理倾向于在简单的自测试后损害先前获得策略。较强的代理更稳定，但它们仍然错误地衡量了部署分布。标准的自编约束并不能可靠地弥补这个差距。相比之下，SEAL在六个模型和三个随机种子上均优于未受保护的基线。可靠的自我改进不必放弃自验证，但它至少需要一个部署接受信号在代理控制之外。

articles.title: The Tokenizer Tax: Quantifying and Explaining the Cross-Lingual Cost of Subword Tokenization for Indian Languages
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) process text through subword tokenizers rather than directly reading characters or words. Because these tokenizers are trained predominantly on English-centric corpora, they introduce a systematic and often overlooked disadvantage for many non-English languages. In this work, we quantify this tokenizer tax for Indian languages using the FLORES-200 parallel corpus, measuring tokenization fertility across six widely used tokenizers and fourteen languages. Under cl100k_base (used by GPT-3.5 and GPT-4), Indian languages experience an average 8.0x tokenization tax relative to English, reaching 13.0x for Malayalam, reducing the effective context window to as little as 12% of that available to English users for equivalent semantic content. We identify the primary mechanism behind this disparity: failed byte-pair merges that leave text fragmented into single-byte tokens, with merge failure strongly correlating with tokenizer tax (Pearson r = 0.89). We further show that this phenomenon is not an inherent property of Indic scripts but a consequence of tokenizer design. Multilingual tokenizers such as XLM-R and OpenAI's o200k_base reduce the average Indic tokenizer tax by 73%, demonstrating that the disparity is largely remediable. Beyond token statistics, we quantify a practical consequence by showing that, under fixed context budgets, Indian-language documents preserve substantially less original content than equivalent English documents. Finally, we examine the relationship between tokenizer fertility and reading comprehension performance on the Belebele benchmark, finding that the apparent correlation is largely explained by language resource availability rather than tokenizer behavior alone.
articles.titleCn: 分词器税：量化并解释印地语等语言中子词分词的跨语言成本
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通过子词分词器处理文本，而非直接读取字符或单词。由于这些分词器主要基于以英语为中心的语料库进行训练，它们为许多非英语语言引入了一种系统性的、且常被忽视的劣势。在本工作中，我们使用FLORES-200平行语料库，量化了印度语言所面临的分词器税，测量了六种常用分词器在十四种语言中的分词能力。在cl100k_base（GPT-3.5和GPT-4使用）下，印度语言相较于英语平均存在8.0倍的分词器税，马拉雅拉姆语更是达到13.0倍，导致其有效上下文窗口仅为英语用户的12%，以同等语义内容而言。我们识别出造成这种差异的主要机制：失败的字节对合并导致文本被分割成单字节分词，合并失败与分词器税强相关（皮尔逊相关系数r=0.89）。我们进一步表明，这种现象并非印度文字的固有属性，而是分词器设计的结果。多语言分词器如XLM-R和OpenAI的o200k_base将平均印度语言分词器税降低了73%，证明这种差异在很大程度上是可以弥补的。除了分词统计，我们通过实验表明，在固定的上下文预算下，印度语言文档保留的原始内容远少于同等英语文档。最后，我们考察了分词能力与贝莱贝莱基准阅读理解性能之间的关系，发现这种表面相关性主要是由语言资源可用性而非分词器行为本身解释的。

articles.title: INS-ActBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Assessing Professional Actuarial Capability of Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong potential in financial reasoning, but existing benchmarks often evaluate domain knowledge, numerical reasoning, long-context understanding, and tool use in separate settings. This limits their ability to assess realistic professional workflows that require auditable, context-grounded, and tool-executable decisions. We introduce \textbf{INS-ActBench}, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating professional actuarial capability in LLMs. INS-ActBench contains 12,050 Q\&A pairs from public exams and sample questions released by 16 actuarial associations. It covers three subsets: \textbf{INS-Act-Know} for standardized actuarial knowledge, \textbf{INS-Act-Case} for long-context insurance case reasoning, and \textbf{INS-Act-Practice} for spreadsheet and R-code tasks with verifiable numerical outputs. Experiments on nine representative LLMs and human actuarial experts reveal a clear capability boundary: frontier LLMs perform strongly on standardized knowledge, but remain much weaker in case reasoning, tool-based workflows, and jurisdiction-sensitive practice. INS-ActBench provides a reproducible foundation for developing actuarial LLMs toward reliable professional assistance. The code is available at https://github.com/FDU-INS/INS-ActBench.
articles.comment: 18 pages, including appendices; 11 figures and 12 tables
articles.titleCn: INS-ActBench：一个用于评估大型语言模型专业精算能力的综合基准
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在金融推理方面展现出巨大潜力，但现有的基准测试通常在分离的环境中评估领域知识、数值推理、长文本理解和工具使用能力。这限制了它们评估需要可审计、基于上下文和可执行工具决策的真实专业工作流程的能力。我们引入了\textbf{INS-ActBench}，这是一个用于评估LLMs专业精算能力的综合基准测试。INS-ActBench包含来自16个精算协会发布的公共考试和样题的12,050个问答对。它涵盖三个子集：\textbf{INS-Act-Know}用于标准化精算知识，\textbf{INS-Act-Case}用于长文本保险案例推理，\textbf{INS-Act-Practice}用于具有可验证数值输出的电子表格和R代码任务。在九个代表性LLMs和人类精算专家上的实验揭示了一个明显的能力边界：前沿LLMs在标准化知识方面表现优异，但在案例推理、基于工具的工作流程和地域敏感的实践方面仍然较弱。INS-ActBench为开发可靠的精算LLMs提供了可重复的基础，以实现专业辅助。代码可在https://github.com/FDU-INS/INS-ActBench获取。

articles.title: Accuracy Hides How Language Models Fail: Measuring Failure States Under Matched Output Budgets
articles.abstract: Language-model benchmarks collapse two distinct measurement questions into a single accuracy score: whether a response reached an evaluable state, and whether its answer was judged correct. We introduce a two-layer evaluation framework that separates scorer-independent execution evidence, including termination, answer exposure, parseability, and completion length, from scorer-dependent correctness. Across 2,550 outputs from five fixed Qwen and DeepSeek configurations on MATH and ARC-Challenge, matched 2,048-token limits produce sharply different execution mixtures: 49 of 450 Qwen MATH outputs terminate without a final answer, compared with 5 of 300 DeepSeek MATH outputs and none of the 750 ARC outputs. Among the same 300 DeepSeek MATH question-model pairs, no missing-final length termination is observed at 8,192 tokens. A coverage-audited targeted verification study further shows that candidate-selection and aggregation policies can substantially alter comparative accuracy estimates. These results demonstrate that accuracy conflates execution case mix with verification policy. Evaluations of test-time methods should therefore report pre-intervention execution states, verification coverage, and scorer provenance alongside accuracy.
articles.titleCn: 准确率隐藏了语言模型失败的方式：在匹配输出预算下测量失败状态
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型基准测试将两个不同的测量问题合并为一个准确率分数：响应是否达到可评估状态，以及其答案是否被判定为正确。我们引入了一个双层评估框架，将与评分器无关的执行证据（包括终止、答案暴露、可解析性和完成长度）与评分器依赖的正确性分离开来。在MATH和ARC-Challenge上五个固定Qwen和DeepSeek配置产生的2,550个输出中，匹配2,048-token限制产生了截然不同的执行组合：450个Qwen MATH输出中有49个在未给出最终答案的情况下终止，而300个DeepSeek MATH输出中只有5个如此，750个ARC输出中则没有。在相同的300个DeepSeek MATH问题-模型对中，8,192-token时未观察到缺失最终长度的终止。一项经过覆盖率审计的针对性验证研究进一步表明，候选选择和聚合策略可以显著改变比较准确率估计。这些结果表明，准确率混淆了执行案例组合与验证策略。因此，测试时方法的评估应报告干预前的执行状态、验证覆盖率和评分器来源，而不仅仅是准确率。

articles.title: Beyond "What to Retrieve": Uncertainty in Retrieval-Augmented Code Generation
articles.abstract: Repository-level code generation relies on heterogeneous evidence whose relevance, compatibility, and completeness are inherently uncertain. Similar-code examples, repository context, and project-specific APIs may provide complementary information, but can also introduce noisy, redundant, or conflicting signals. Existing retrieval-augmented approaches primarily optimize retrieval relevance without explicitly modeling how uncertainty in retrieved evidence affects downstream generation. We introduce OpenCoder, an uncertainty-aware framework that estimates source-specific uncertainty, uses it to filter and rank heterogeneous evidence, and guides generation, verification, and repair. A factorial analysis over API knowledge, repository context, and similar-code evidence reveals no universal additive source ranking; instead, significant cross-source interactions depend on the accompanying evidence and LLM backend. On an expanded 32-task RepoExec-inline evaluation, OpenCoder improves GPT selected-output correctness over Baseline RAG from 56.25\% to 78.13\%. However, it matches a verification-and-repair control, and the corresponding Gemini improvement is not statistically supported, indicating backend-dependent benefits. Target-aware API refinement also substantially improves API-set retrieval. These findings support treating uncertainty as an actionable control signal for repository-level retrieval, verification, and repair.
articles.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Source code and supporting materials are available at https://github.com/Rocky5502/OpenCoder_V1
articles.titleCn: 超越“检索什么”：检索增强型代码生成中的不确定性
articles.abstractCn: 仓库级别的代码生成依赖于异构证据，其相关性、兼容性和完整性本质上具有不确定性。相似代码示例、仓库上下文和项目特定API可能提供互补信息，但也可能引入噪声、冗余或冲突信号。现有的检索增强方法主要优化检索相关性，而没有明确建模检索证据中的不确定性如何影响下游生成。我们引入了OpenCoder，这是一个感知不确定性的框架，它估计特定源的不确定性，并利用该不确定性过滤和排序异构证据，指导生成、验证和修复。对API知识、仓库上下文和相似代码证据的因子分析揭示，没有通用的源排序加性；相反，显著的跨源交互取决于伴随的证据和LLM后端。在一个扩展的32任务RepoExec-inline评估中，OpenCoder将GPT选择输出的正确性从基线RAG的56.25%提高到78.13%。然而，它与验证和修复控制匹配，相应的Gemini改进没有统计支持，表明了后端依赖性优势。目标感知的API细化也显著提高了API集检索。这些发现支持将不确定性视为仓库级别检索、验证和修复的可操作控制信号。

articles.title: CAGE: Cognitive Attribution Graphs for Faithful Inline Citation Generation in Long-Form Question Answering

authors.name: Shizhao Li
authors.affiliation: Cognitive Attribution Graphs for Citation Generation

articles.abstract: Long-form question answering increasingly relies on retrieved evidence to make LLM outputs verifiable, with inline citations tracing claims to source documents. However, existing systems often attach citations that are topically related but insufficient to support their claims. We identify attribution ambiguity as a structural challenge: end-to-end generation must implicitly resolve combinatorial claim--document assignments, obscuring evidential boundaries and increasing the risk of evidence-boundary overrun, where claims exceed cited support. To address this challenge, we propose CAGE (Cognitive Attribution Graphs for Citation Generation), a two-stage framework that introduces an explicit cognitive attribution map before answer generation. CAGE first trains a plug-and-play Cognitive Map Induction Model to construct answer-centered support subgraphs, aligning each semantic answer unit with supporting documents through explicit relations. A Structured Citation Reasoning Model then realizes these units as sentence-level claims with map-aligned citations. Experiments on ASQA, ELI5, and ExpertQA show that CAGE achieves state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating the effectiveness of attribution-space contraction and map-guided citation generation.
articles.titleCn: CAGE：用于长文本问答中忠实内联引文生成的认知归因图
articles.abstractCn: 长文本问答越来越多地依赖检索证据来确保大语言模型输出的可验证性，通过内联引用将主张追溯到源文档。然而，现有系统往往附加的主题相关但不足以支持其主张的引用。我们识别出归因模糊性作为结构挑战：端到端生成必须隐式解决组合式主张—文档分配，模糊证据边界并增加证据边界超出的风险，即主张超出引用支持。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了CAGE（认知归因图用于引用生成），一个两阶段框架，在答案生成前引入显式的认知归因图。CAGE首先训练一个即插即用的认知图诱导模型来构建以答案为中心的支持子图，通过显式关系将每个语义答案单元与支持文档对齐。然后，结构化引用推理模型将这些单元实现为句子级别的声明，并使用图对齐的引用。在ASQA、ELI5和ExpertQA上的实验表明，CAGE达到了最先进的性能，证明了归因空间收缩和图引导引用生成的有效性。

articles.title: A New Role for Relevance: Guiding Corpus Interaction in Agentic Search
articles.abstract: Relevance is a query-dependent estimate of whether a document or excerpt contains useful evidence. Existing retrieval agents use relevance to select top-$k$ content, but document relevance alone cannot localize, compose, or verify the evidence required by complex questions. Direct Corpus Interaction (DCI) enables such fine-grained operations through grep-style exploration, but its relevance-agnostic search can expose useful clues late and delay convergence. Recent advances use relevance to narrow the corpus into a working space for interaction. Once interaction begins, however, relevance still does not directly guide which documents grep searches first or distinguish informative excerpts from a broad set of matches to let LLMs see them first. We introduce the Relevance-Aware RipGrep Search Agent (RARG), which turns relevance into an execution prior for corpus interaction. RARG provides coarse-to-fine relevance guidance: it orders documents for sequential 'ripgrep' traversal to expose globally relevant clues earlier, initializes promising entry points with query-relevant paragraphs, and reranks grep matches to surface informative excerpts that document-level ranking may otherwise obscure. Across challenging browse question answering and reasoning-intensive retrieval, RARG improves the accuracy--efficiency frontier over retrieval-based and direct-interaction agents. These results demonstrate that relevance-aware interaction enables faster and more reliable search convergence.
articles.titleCn: 相关性新角色：在自主搜索中引导语料库交互
articles.abstractCn: 相关性是针对查询评估文档或摘录是否包含有用证据的一种估计。现有的检索代理使用相关性来选择前k位内容，但仅靠文档相关性无法定位、组合或验证复杂问题所需的证据。直接语料库交互（DCI）通过类似grep的探索实现此类细粒度操作，但其无关性搜索可能延迟揭示有用线索并延缓收敛。近期进展利用相关性将语料库缩小为交互的工作空间。然而，一旦交互开始，相关性仍无法直接指导grep搜索优先检索哪些文档，也无法从广泛的匹配集中区分信息性摘录让大语言模型优先查看。我们引入了相关性感知RipGrep搜索代理（RARG），将相关性转化为语料库交互的执行先验。RARG提供从粗到细的相关性指导：它对文档进行排序以实现顺序'ripgrep'遍历，从而更早地揭示全局相关线索，用与查询相关的段落初始化有希望的入口点，并对grep匹配结果重新排序以浮现信息性摘录——这些摘录可能因文档级排序而被掩盖。在具有挑战性的浏览式问答和需要推理的检索任务中，RARG相较于基于检索和直接交互的代理提升了准确率-效率边界。这些结果表明，相关性感知交互能够实现更快、更可靠的搜索收敛。

articles.title: Agent Retrieval Bench: Evaluating Repository Context Retrieval for Coding Agents
articles.abstract: Modern coding agents are usually evaluated by whether they eventually produce a correct patch, but patch generation depends on an earlier context-acquisition stage: finding the repository files needed for the task. We introduce Agent Retrieval Bench, a file-level benchmark for this upstream retrieval problem. Samples are built from real coding-workflow signals and evaluated against frozen base-commit repositories, with relevance defined by what an agent needs next rather than direct query-file semantic similarity. The benchmark covers four positive-retrieval tasks: code2test, comment2context, trace2code, and edit2ripple; a fifth subset evaluates selective retrieval using natural evidence-backed no-gold cases and counterfactual wrong-repository controls. Agent Retrieval Bench contains 427 samples across 25 repositories: 345 positive examples, 50 natural no-gold examples, and 32 counterfactual controls. The corpus includes 308 base-commit snapshots, 392,000 files, and 7.9 million chunks. We evaluate lexical retrieval, RepoMap, open-source embeddings, selective abstention, and logged agent context selection. No single retrieval family dominates: Qwen3-Embedding-4B has the best sample-weighted MRR on positive samples, Qwen3-Embedding-8B the best Recall@20, and RepoMap the best budgeted context yield at 8K tokens, with task-level winners differing substantially. Selective thresholds calibrated with counterfactual controls do not improve selective success on natural no-gold cases, revealing a calibration gap. Logged trajectories also miss every gold file on 27-35 percent of samples. A controlled seed-intervention pilot finds that retrieval-derived initial context yields higher file F1 with less post-seed exploration than random non-gold context, while oracle gold context shows substantial remaining headroom.
articles.titleCn: 代理检索基准：评估代码代理的仓库上下文检索
articles.abstractCn: 现代编程代理通常通过它们最终是否生成正确补丁来评估，但补丁生成依赖于更早的上下文获取阶段：找到执行任务所需的仓库文件。我们引入了Agent Retrieval Bench，这是一个针对此上游检索问题的文件级基准。样本基于真实的编程工作流程信号构建，并在冻结的基线提交仓库上进行评估，相关性由代理下一步需要的内容定义，而非直接查询文件的语义相似度。该基准涵盖四个正向检索任务：code2test、comment2context、trace2code和edit2ripple；第五个子集使用基于自然证据的无金标案例和反事实错误仓库控制来评估选择性检索。Agent Retrieval Bench包含25个仓库中的427个样本：345个正向示例、50个自然无金标示例和32个反事实控制。语料库包括308个基线提交快照、392,000个文件和7.9百万个片段。我们评估了词汇检索、RepoMap、开源嵌入、选择性放弃和记录的代理上下文选择。没有单一检索家族占据主导地位：Qwen3-Embedding-4B在正向样本上的样本加权MRR最佳，Qwen3-Embedding-8B的Recall@20最佳，而RepoMap在8K令牌预算下具有最佳的上下文产出，不同任务层面的获胜者差异显著。使用反事实控制校准的选择性阈值并未提高自然无金标案例的选择性成功率，揭示了校准差距。记录的轨迹在27-35%的样本中遗漏了每个金标文件。一项受控的种子干预试点发现，检索生成的初始上下文比随机非金标上下文需要更少的种子后探索，就能获得更高的文件F1，而金标上下文显示出显著的剩余改进空间。

articles.title: LLM-based Source Code Compression via Thresholded Symbol Ranking
articles.abstract: We study the problem of lossless compression of source code, motivated by the storage demands of large-scale software archives, such as Software Heritage (https://www.softwareheritage.org/). General-purpose compressors (e.g., zstd, bzip2) offer a good trade-off between compression ratio and speed, but fail to exploit all special regularities inherent in source code. Recent approaches leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) within Shannon's symbol-ranking framework, relying on a scheme in which the predicted rank can grow arbitrarily. While effective at reducing space, this setting incurs significant throughput degradation, and leaves open the question whether it is necessary to explicitly encode all ranks. In this work, we introduce LLM-based compressors deploying two novel symbol-ranking variants that bound predictions to the top-$T$ ranks ($T=1$ or $63$), with out-of-threshold symbols stored as exceptions and compressed jointly with the rank stream via general-purpose compressors. We conduct the first large-scale evaluation of LLM-based source code compression across 30 LLMs, including general-domain, code-specialized, and quantized models. Our $T$-bounded approach outperforms prior LLM-based compressors both in compression ratio (up to 37% relative improvement) and compression throughput (40% faster). Compared to general-purpose compressors (e.g., zstd, bzip2), we obtain up to 82% relative compression gain but at a lower speed, thus offering a new trade-off point in the compression-speed spectrum. We also show that these gains are stronger on source code than on natural language, suggesting an interesting indication, namely that source code exposes regularities captured by LLMs but missed by general-purpose exact-match-based compressors. We conclude by commenting on open problems that offer theoretical and practical avenues of research.

The paper will appear in the proceedings, published by Springer Verlag in the Lecture Notes in Artificial Intelligence (LNAI) series
articles.titleCn: 基于LLM的源代码压缩方法：阈值符号排序
articles.abstractCn: 我们研究了源代码的无损压缩问题，这源于大规模软件档案（如软件遗产 Software Heritage）的存储需求。通用压缩器（例如 zstd、bzip2）在压缩率和速度之间提供了良好的权衡，但未能利用源代码中固有的所有特殊规律性。近期的方法在香农符号排序框架内利用大型语言模型（LLMs），依赖于一种预测排名可以任意增长的方案。虽然这种方法在减少存储空间方面很有效，但会导致显著的吞吐量下降，并且留下了是否必须显式编码所有排名的问题。在这项工作中，我们引入了基于LLM的压缩器，部署了两种新型符号排序变体，将预测限制在顶部-T排名（T=1或63）内，超出阈值的符号作为异常存储，并通过通用压缩器与排名流一起压缩。我们对30种LLM（包括通用领域、代码专用和量化模型）进行了基于LLM的源代码压缩的大规模评估。我们的T受限方法在压缩率（相对提升高达37%）和压缩吞吐量（速度提升40%）方面均优于先前的基于LLM的压缩器。与通用压缩器（例如zstd、bzip2）相比，我们获得了高达82%的相对压缩增益，但速度较慢，从而在压缩-速度谱中提供了一个新的权衡点。我们还表明，这些增益在源代码上比在自然语言上更显著，这表明源代码暴露了LLM所捕捉但通用精确匹配压缩器所遗漏的规律性。最后，我们对开放问题进行了评论，为理论和实践研究提供了方向。

articles.title: StanceFlip: A Comprehensive Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Multimodal Conversational Stance Flipping Forecasting
articles.abstract: Conversational stance detection has shifted from static text analysis to dynamic multimodal modeling. However, existing benchmarks exhibit three key limitations: failure to capture the dynamic evolution of beliefs, particularly during stance reversals; difficulty in disentangling affective states from logical reasoning; and neglect of the critical role of multimodal cues in resolving pragmatic ambiguities such as sarcasm. To address these limitations, we propose StanceFlip, a benchmark designed for multimodal conversational stance flipping forecasting over multi-turn dialogues across five modalities and multi-scenarios, which includes two novel subtasks: 1) Multimodal Stance Sextuple Extraction, extracting holder, target, emotion, sentiment, stance, and rationale as static state snapshots of dialogue to capture fine-grained cognitive structures. 2) Dynamic Stance Flip Attribution, tracking stance reversals across the conversation and identifying their underlying triggers. Alongside the dataset, we propose a dedicated framework, named ConStaFF, for Multimodal Conversational Stance Flipping Forecasting (MCSFF). Built upon a large language model, ConStaFF performs end-to-end stance reasoning, with a Thought-of-Stance (ToS) reasoning framework and a self-reflective verification mechanism integrated for structured stance modeling and faithful flip attribution. Specifically, ToS decomposes the reasoning process into specialized cognitive personas to formulate target propositions, resolve cross-modal conflicts, and infer historical stance trajectories. Extensive experiments show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on both sextuple extraction and flip-trigger attribution, outperforming strong multimodal large language model baselines by substantial margins.
articles.titleCn: 立场翻转：一个用于多模态对话立场翻转预测的全面多维基准
articles.abstractCn: 对话立场检测已从静态文本分析转向动态多模态建模。然而，现有基准存在三个关键局限：未能捕捉信念的动态演变，尤其是在立场反转过程中；难以将情感状态与逻辑推理分离；忽视了多模态线索在解决讽刺等语用模糊性中的关键作用。为解决这些局限，我们提出了StanceFlip，这是一个用于多轮对话中五模态多场景多模态对话立场反转预测的基准，其中包括两个新型子任务：1) 多模态立场六元组提取，将持有者、目标、情绪、情感、立场和理由作为对话的静态状态快照提取出来，以捕捉细粒度的认知结构；2) 动态立场反转归因，追踪对话中的立场反转并识别其潜在触发因素。除了数据集之外，我们还提出了一个专门框架，名为ConStaFF，用于多模态对话立场反转预测（MCSFF）。基于大型语言模型，ConStaFF执行端到端的立场推理，集成了立场思维（ToS）推理框架和自我反思验证机制，用于结构化立场建模和忠实立场反转归因。具体而言，ToS将推理过程分解为专门的认知角色，以制定目标命题、解决跨模态冲突并推断历史立场轨迹。大量实验表明，我们的方法在六元组提取和反转触发归因方面均达到了最先进性能，大幅优于强大的多模态大型语言模型基线。

articles.title: Where Quality Breaks in Compressed Short-Text Generation: Staged Bottleneck Localization
articles.abstract: Compressed short-text generators can fail in two different places: the codec may discard information before generation starts, or the latent generator may produce weak codes. Without separating these failure modes, researchers can spend compute improving the wrong component. We study this problem in a controlled 64-to-16 TinyStories case study built from a hierarchical VQ-VAE-2 codec and a masked discrete diffusion generator (MDLM). We use a staged validation protocol that separates codec reconstruction fidelity, latent generation quality, and auxiliary latent diagnostics under one shared external GPT-2 scorer, while reporting complementary semantic metrics for the geometry study. In the tested configuration, codec reconstruction alone raises median external perplexity from 15.17 to 27.36 (+80.4%) and p95 from 25.10 to 98.91 (+294.1%), showing that the dominant quality loss appears before latent generation begins. Under the same scorer, code-space MDLM remains materially stronger than token-space diffusion, reducing mean, median, and p95 by 32.9%, 30.9%, and 36.6%, respectively. Geometry-aware regularization improves local latent proxies but does not improve decoded-text metrics in the available runs. The contribution is methodological rather than algorithmic: the paper presents a reusable staged diagnosis for one concrete pipeline and shows that, in this setting, codec fidelity rather than latent denoising sets the practical quality ceiling.
articles.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 14 tables. Published in the Proceedings of FRUCT'39
articles.titleCn: 压缩短文本生成中的质量瓶颈阶段定位
articles.abstractCn: 压缩短文本生成器可能在两个不同的地方失效：编解码器可能在生成开始前丢弃信息，或者潜在生成器可能产生弱编码。如果不区分这些失效模式，研究人员可能会花费计算资源去改进错误的组件。我们在一个由分层VQ-VAE-2编解码器和掩码离散扩散生成器（MDLM）构建的64到16的TinyStories受控案例研究中研究这个问题。我们使用了一个分阶段的验证协议，将编解码器重建保真度、潜在生成质量和辅助潜在诊断统一在一个共享的外部GPT-2评分器下，同时在几何研究中报告互补的语义指标。在测试配置中，仅编解码器重建就将中位数外部困惑度从15.17提高到27.36（+80.4%），p95从25.10提高到98.91（+294.1%），表明主要的质量损失出现在潜在生成开始之前。在相同的评分器下，编码空间MDLM仍然明显强于标记空间扩散，分别将均值、中位数和p95降低了32.9%、30.9%和36.6%。几何感知正则化改进了局部潜在代理，但在可用的运行中并未改善解码文本指标。这项贡献是方法论上的而非算法上的：论文提出了一种可重用的分阶段诊断方法，用于一个具体的流程，并表明在这个设置中，编解码器的保真度而非潜在去噪设定了实际质量上限。

articles.title: Do Current Retrievers Cover All the Evidence? A Controlled Study of Conjunctive Cross-Page Retrieval
articles.abstract: Finding a long document relevant to a multi-part request is not the same as establishing that it contains every requested piece of evidence. We study this gap for conjunctive document retrieval, where two or three explicit conditions must be supported on different pages of one document. We use n-Clue as a controlled measurement instrument: 1{,}000 queries over 2{,}021 documents pair all-condition golds with naturally occurring documents that satisfy only a subset, and a complete-first success requires a top-10 gold to precede every released subset qrel. Across 70 configurations, condition-wise decomposition improves two dense backbones by 6.8--7.3 points and lexical--visual fusion adds 8.7, while four generic rerankers all reduce Gold-NDCG; these directions replicate on a four-source stress set. Scaling one dense family from 0.6B to 8B changes complete-first success by 0.0 points. The strongest displayed hybrid illustrates the resulting gap: it finds a gold for 81.1\% of queries but succeeds complete-first on only 35.8\%, and the gap persists across condition count, target length, candidate density, query rendering, and the four-source stress set. Finally, page-aware visual systems surface stored support for every condition on only 5.1--5.3\% of queries. These results identify condition coverage, rather than gold discovery alone, as the central bottleneck.
articles.titleCn: 当前检索器是否涵盖所有证据？一项关于联合跨页检索的受控研究
articles.abstractCn: 在多部分请求中找到与相关长文档并非等同于证明该文档包含所有请求的证据。我们研究了联合文档检索中的这一差距，其中需要在文档的不同页面上支持两个或三个显式条件。我们使用n-Clue作为受控测量工具：在2,021份文档上的1,000个查询将所有条件黄金标准与仅满足部分条件的自然文档配对，而完整优先成功需要排名前10的黄金标准在所有已发布的子集qrel之前。在70种配置中，条件分解使两种密集主干模型提升6.8至7.3分，词汇-视觉融合增加8.7，而四种通用重排序器均降低Gold-NDCG；这些方向在四源压力集上得到验证。将一种密集模型从0.6B扩展到8B，完整优先成功率未变。表现最强的混合模型展示了这一差距：它为81.1%的查询找到黄金标准，但在完整优先成功上仅达35.8%，且这一差距在条件数量、目标长度、候选密度、查询渲染和四源压力集上持续存在。最后，页面感知视觉系统仅在5.1至5.3%的查询中为每个条件显示存储的支持。这些结果表明，条件覆盖而非仅黄金发现，是核心瓶颈。

articles.title: Looking for Affect in Spontaneous Finnish Speech through Linguistic Interpretability
articles.abstract: Existing research on affect in speech has shown how acoustic surface characteristics and content-related linguistic aspects of speech both relate to perceived emotional arousal and valence. However, it is not clear what the relative contributions of these two factors are in the perceptual process. This is especially true for Finnish, for which most existing studies focus on either acoustic-phonetic or text analysis. This paper presents a study where we systematically explore the combinatory role of text- and audio-based features in modeling the human perception of valence and arousal using a newly released affective speech corpus for spontaneous Finnish. We show that the combination of text- and audio-based features improves valence regression results over the individual modalities, whereas for arousal regression the complementary effect is not substantial. The results support prior findings from other languages, providing new data and knowledge on spontaneous Finnish speech.
articles.comment: Accepted for publication at Interspeech 2026, Sydney, Australia
articles.titleCn: 通过语言可解释性在自发芬兰语中寻找情感
articles.abstractCn: 现有关于语音情感的研究表明，语音的声学表面特征和与内容相关的语言方面都与感知到的情绪唤醒度和效价相关。然而，这两种因素的相对贡献在感知过程中尚不明确。这一点对于芬兰语尤其如此，因为大多数现有研究都集中在声韵学分析或文本分析上。本文提出一项研究，我们系统地探索了文本和音频特征在建模自发芬兰语人类对效价和唤醒度的感知中的组合作用，使用了新发布的自发芬兰语情感语音语料库。我们发现，文本和音频特征的组合提高了效价回归结果，而唤醒度回归则没有显著的互补效应。这些结果支持了其他语言先前的研究发现，为自发芬兰语语音提供了新的数据和知识。

articles.title: BioSentinel at EXIST 2026: Soft-Label Optimization with XLM-RoBERTa for Sexism Intent Classification in Memes
articles.abstract: This paper describes the BioSentinel team's participation in EXIST 2026 Task 2.2: Source Intention in Memes, part of the CLEF 2026 evaluation campaign. The task requires classifying the communicative intent behind memes as direct, judgemental, or no (non-sexist), under a Learning with Disagreement (Le-Wi-Di) paradigm that mandates both hard-label and soft-label (probability distribution) predictions. We present a text-centric approach built on xlm-roberta-base (270M parameters) trained with a composite loss function combining KL divergence on soft annotator distributions and weighted cross-entropy on hard labels. On the official test set, the system achieved an ICM-Soft-Norm of 0.3229 and ICM-Norm of 0.3778, with a hard F1-score of 0.4236, ranking 40th (out of 118 submissions) in the soft-soft evaluation and 49th (out of 187 submissions) in the hard-hard evaluation. We provide an analysis of the dataset characteristics, exploratory larger-architecture runs, and the role of annotator disagreement in shaping model design for subjective NLP tasks. Ablation results show that KL loss improves soft-label metrics, while CE loss improves hard-label accuracy. We also report a separate validation-set temperature analysis.
articles.comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Accepted for publication in the CLEF 2026 Working Notes (EXIST 2026), Jena, Germany
articles.titleCn: BioSentinel在EXIST 2026：使用XLM-RoBERTa进行软标签优化，用于表情包中的性别歧视意图分类
articles.abstractCn: 本文介绍了BioSentinel团队参与CLEF 2026评估活动中的EXIST 2026任务2.2：表情包中的来源意图。该任务要求在Learning with Disagreement (Le-Wi-Di)范式下，对表情包背后的交际意图进行分类，分为直接、评判或无（非性别歧视）三类，并需同时输出硬标签和软标签（概率分布）预测。我们提出了一种基于xlm-roberta-base（270M参数）的文本中心方法，该方法使用结合KL散度（针对软标注者分布）和加权交叉熵（针对硬标签）的复合损失函数进行训练。在官方测试集上，系统取得了ICM-Soft-Norm 0.3229和ICM-Norm 0.3778的成绩，硬标签F1分数为0.4236，在软-软评估中排名第40（共118份提交），在硬-硬评估中排名第49（共187份提交）。我们分析了数据集特征、探索性更大架构运行以及标注者分歧在塑造主观NLP任务模型设计中的作用。消融实验表明KL损失提升了软标签指标，而CE损失提高了硬标签准确率。我们还报告了独立的验证集温度分析。

articles.title: LLM-Based vs. Lexicon-Based Sentiment Signals for Tail-Risk Detection in Meme Stocks
articles.abstract: This paper presents an empirical comparison of lexicon-based and Large Language Model (LLM)-based sentiment analysis for extracting market-relevant signals from social media discourse in highly volatile equity markets. Using Reddit data from r/WallStreetBets and focusing on meme stocks (GME, AMC, NOK), we construct time-aligned sentiment indicators and evaluate their relationship with market returns, with particular attention to extreme positive return events in the upper tail of the return distribution. The LLM-based approach generates multidimensional sentiment representations capturing emotional polarity, bullishness, sarcasm likelihood, and topical relevance, whereas the baseline relies on the VADER lexicon-based model. We evaluate both approaches using lead/lag correlation analysis, OLS regression, ROC-AUC-based directional classification, and a quantile-based early-warning framework. The results indicate that LLM-derived indicators provide a richer multidimensional representation and exhibit stronger asset-specific statistical structure than the lexicon-based baseline. However, their relationship with market movements remains heterogeneous across assets, suggesting that increased linguistic expressiveness does not necessarily translate into stable forecasting performance in retail-driven volatility regimes.
articles.titleCn: 基于大型语言模型的情感信号与基于词汇的情感信号在模因股尾部风险检测中的比较
articles.abstractCn: 本文对基于词典和基于大型语言模型（LLM）的情感分析方法进行了实证比较，旨在从高波动性股票市场的社交媒体讨论中提取市场相关信号。我们使用来自r/WallStreetBets的Reddit数据，重点关注GME、AMC、NOK等“梗股”，构建了时间对齐的情感指标，并评估了这些指标与市场回报的关系，尤其关注回报分布上尾部的极端正回报事件。基于LLM的方法能够生成多维情感表征，捕捉情感极性、看涨倾向、讽刺可能性及主题相关性，而基线方法则依赖VADER词典模型。我们通过领先/滞后相关性分析、普通最小二乘回归、基于ROC-AUC的方向分类以及基于分位数的预警框架对两种方法进行评估。结果表明，LLM衍生指标提供了更丰富的多维表征，并展现出比词典基线更强的资产特定统计结构。然而，它们与市场波动的关系在不同资产间存在异质性，表明在散户驱动波动环境下，语言表达的丰富性并不必然转化为稳定的预测性能。

articles.title: ACRL: Adaptive Control of Training-Inference Discrepancy for Stable Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) training for Large Language Models (LLMs) often suffers from instability due to the discrepancy between training and inference. This training-inference discrepancy stems from two primary factors: an architectural separation between training and inference engines, and the use of low-precision quantization in inference versus higher-precision computation in training. To address training instability issues caused by high training-inference discrepancy, we present the principles and methods for its adaptive control. We propose Adaptive Control Reinforcement Learning (ACRL), which adaptively maintains the training-inference discrepancy within a reasonable range to ensure stable RL training. Beyond stabilization, ACRL inherently increases policy entropy, thereby enhancing exploration and improving accuracy. The experimental results show that when the inference engine utilizes FP8 quantization, ACRL consistently maintains the training-inference discrepancy within a reasonable range and stabilizes RL training. Furthermore, ACRL not only matches the accuracy of the BF16 baseline but also outperforms importance sampling (IS) fixes.
articles.titleCn: ACRL：自适应控制训练-推理差异以实现稳定强化学习
articles.abstractCn: 强化学习（RL）在大语言模型（LLM）中的训练常常因训练与推理之间的差异而出现不稳定性。这种训练-推理差异主要源于两个因素：训练与推理引擎之间的架构分离，以及推理中使用低精度量化而训练中使用高精度计算。为解决由高训练-推理差异引起的不稳定性问题，我们提出了自适应控制的原则和方法。我们提出了自适应控制强化学习（ACRL），它自适应地保持训练-推理差异在合理范围内，以确保稳定的RL训练。除了稳定化之外，ACRL本质上增加了策略熵，从而增强探索并提高准确性。实验结果表明，当推理引擎使用FP8量化时，ACRL始终将训练-推理差异保持在合理范围内，并稳定了RL训练。此外，ACRL不仅达到了BF16基线的准确性，还优于重要性采样（IS）修复。

articles.title: Pointer-Augmented Autoregressive Generation of Patent Claims with Joint Topology and Content Decoding
articles.abstract: Autoregressive decoders emit flat token sequences and cannot enforce hierarchical constraints across output segments, a limitation that becomes acute in patent claim generation, where a claim set forms a dependency forest whose scope must narrow monotonically with depth. Topology and content are mutually dependent: a dependent claim's wording must reflect its parent's scope, yet the parent must be chosen before that wording exists, so neither post-hoc parsing nor grammar-constrained decoding suffices. We propose SPG (Structure-aware Patent Generation), which predicts topology inside the autoregressive pass. A pointer head selects each dependent claim's parent, and its gradients, together with a depth-adaptive scope regularizer, reshape the shared decoder's representations during training. A second stage then applies a violation-weighted preference objective over self-generated deficient candidates, supplying the negative signal that granted-patent corpora lack. On HUPD-DCG, SPG on Llama-3-8B-Instruct recovers 79.0\% of gold parent links, a quantity its training reward never supervises, and raises antecedent consistency from 0.292 to 0.478 over a supervised baseline of equal scale, with expert evaluation corroborating these gains.
articles.titleCn: 指针增强型专利权利要求自回归生成，联合拓扑与内容解码
articles.abstractCn: 自回归解码器会发出扁平化的标记序列，并且无法在输出片段之间强制执行层级约束，这一限制在专利权利要求生成中尤为突出，因为在专利权利要求集中，权利要求集形成了一个依赖森林，其作用范围必须随着深度单调缩小。拓扑结构和内容是相互依赖的：一个从属权利要求的措辞必须反映其父项的范围，但父项必须在措辞存在之前被选定，因此事后解析或语法约束解码都不足以满足需求。我们提出了SPG（结构感知专利生成），它可以在自回归过程中预测拓扑结构。一个指针头选择每个从属权利要求的父项，其梯度与深度自适应范围正则化器共同在训练期间重塑共享解码器的表示。然后，第二阶段对自我生成的缺陷候选应用违规加权偏好目标，提供授权专利语料库所缺乏的负信号。在HUPD-DCG上，SPG在Llama-3-8B-Instruct上恢复了79.0%的金标准父项链接，这一数量其训练奖励从未监督，并且将前驱一致性从0.292提高到0.478，超过了规模相同的监督基线，专家评估证实了这些提升。

articles.title: MoLGE: Mixture of Language Group Experts for Efficient Scaling of Massively Multilingual Speech Recognition
articles.abstract: Massively multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR) models covering hundreds of languages must maintain robust performance across diverse linguistic and acoustic conditions. However, these models often encounter the curse of multilinguality, where model capacity is diluted across languages. To address this challenge, we propose Mixture of Language Group Experts (MoLGE), built upon speech self-supervised models (S3Ms). MoLGE assigns dedicated expert modules to clusters of similar languages, reducing the number of required submodules compared to conventional language-specific Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) schemes. It further integrates a hierarchical Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) strategy into the disentangled acoustic and linguistic components of the S3M architecture, enabling efficient modeling of language-specific characteristics while maintaining parameter efficiency. Further, we investigate the impact of language grouping strategies based on both linguistic and data-driven criteria on overall performance, providing an interpretable perspective on how language structure influences scalability in multilingual speech systems. In experiments, we evaluate MoLGE on a multilingual benchmark encompassing 495 languages. Results demonstrate that MoLGE consistently outperforms dense multilingual baselines with a minimal increase in trainable parameters. Notably, these language grouping strategies yield substantial improvements for both phonetic and orthographic aspects of ASR modeling. Our findings suggest that structured language specialization provides an effective pathway for massively scaling language coverage of multilingual ASR.
articles.titleCn: MoLGE：用于大规模多语言语音识别高效扩展的语言组专家混合模型
articles.abstractCn: 覆盖数百种语言的超大语言自动语音识别（ASR）模型必须在多样的语言和声学条件下保持稳健性能。然而，这些模型常面临多语言诅咒问题，即模型能力因分散到多种语言而稀释。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了基于语音自监督模型（S3M）构建的语言组专家混合模型（MoLGE）。MoLGE为相似语言簇分配专用专家模块，相较于传统的特定语言专家混合（MoE）方案，减少了所需子模块数量。此外，它将分层低秩适配（LoRA）策略集成到S3M架构的解耦声学和语言组件中，在保持参数效率的同时，实现了对语言特定特征的高效建模。进一步地，我们研究了基于语言和基于数据驱动标准构建语言分组策略对整体性能的影响，从可解释的角度揭示了语言结构如何影响多语言语音系统的可扩展性。在实验中，我们在包含495种语言的多元语言基准上评估了MoLGE。结果表明，MoLGE始终优于密集多元语言基线，且训练参数仅略有增加。值得注意的是，这些语言分组策略显著提升了ASR建模在语音和正字法方面的性能。我们的研究结果表明，结构化的语言专业化为大规模扩展多语言ASR的语言覆盖范围提供了有效途径。

articles.title: SyRuP: Enhancing System-Prompt Following via Reward-Guided Prediction in LLM Decoding
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly controlled through system prompts that specify roles, styles, formats, and safety requirements. However, models follow these prompts only implicitly through in-context learning, which can be insufficient for complex or compositional prompts. Existing approaches often require model tuning or response-level reranking, limiting their practicality for lightweight inference-time control. We introduce SyRuP, a decoding-time framework for improving system-prompt adherence while keeping the base LM frozen. SyRuP trains a cross-attention reward head from system-prompt-conditioned preference pairs, treating the system prompt as a separate memory to produce token-level adherence scores. At inference, SyRuP reranks the base LM's top-k candidates by combining base logits with the learned reward signal and an optional contrastive signal capturing system-induced logit shifts. Experiments on system-prompt following benchmarks show that SyRuP consistently outperforms prompting and decoding-time baselines with moderate inference overhead. These results suggest that explicit token-level guidance is an effective and practical mechanism for reliable system-prompt following.
articles.titleCn: SyRuP：通过在LLM解码中采用奖励引导预测来增强系统提示遵循能力
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地通过系统提示来控制，这些提示指定了角色、风格、格式和安全要求。然而，模型仅通过情境学习隐式地遵循这些提示，这对于复杂或组合性提示可能不足。现有方法通常需要模型调优或响应级重新排序，限制了它们在轻量级推理时控制中的实用性。我们引入了SyRuP，这是一个在解码时改进系统提示遵循性的框架，同时保持基础LLM不变。SyRuP通过系统提示条件下的偏好对来训练交叉注意力奖励头，将系统提示视为一个单独的记忆来生成token级别的遵循性分数。在推理时，SyRuP通过结合基础logits、学习到的奖励信号以及可选的对比信号（捕捉系统引起的logit偏移）来重新排序基础LLM的top-k候选。在系统提示遵循性基准测试上的实验表明，SyRuP始终优于提示和解码时基线，且推理开销适中。这些结果表明，显式的token级别指导是一种有效且实用的机制，用于可靠地遵循系统提示。

articles.title: MEMOIR: Temporal Behavioral Memory for Recommendation Across the Preference-Drift Spectrum
articles.abstract: We propose MEMOIR, a framework that segments user interaction histories into temporal windows, generates semantic behavioral memory for each period using an LLM, and aggregates current state, evolution direction, and predicted future into a single user representation. On the Electronics and Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry categories of Amazon Reviews 2023, MEMOIR is statistically tied with UniSRec, the strongest baseline, on aggregate NDCG@10 (0.0643 vs. 0.0641), splitting the four reported metrics 2-2: MEMOIR leads NDCG@10 and MRR, UniSRec leads HR@10 and HR@20. An ablation study finds that no single architectural component - the evolution-preserving contrastive loss, its directional-consistency term, or temporal window segmentation itself - individually explains much of MEMOIR's approximately 18% relative gain over ID-based SASRec; all four ablations land within 2% of the full model on aggregate NDCG@10. Stratifying test performance by a composite preference-drift score instead reveals where the gain concentrates: MEMOIR leads on ranking-quality metrics (NDCG@10, MRR) specifically among users at the high- and low-drift extremes of the distribution, while UniSRec leads the volume-oriented HR@10/HR@20 metrics across all drift strata and edges out MEMOIR on ranking quality in the middle band. We report this drift-stratified pattern, rather than the near-tied aggregate numbers or any single ablated component, as MEMOIR's most substantive and reproducible finding, and surface why it holds as an open question for future work.
articles.titleCn: 回忆录：跨越偏好漂移谱系的推荐时序行为记忆
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了MEMOIR框架，该框架将用户交互历史分割成时间窗口，使用大型语言模型为每个时期生成语义行为记忆，并将当前状态、演化方向和预测未来聚合为单一用户表示。在亚马逊评论2023年的电子产品和服装鞋包珠宝类别中，MEMOIR在聚合NDCG@10指标上与UniSRec（最强的基线模型）统计上持平（0.0643 vs. 0.0641），四项报告指标平分秋色：MEMOIR在NDCG@10和MRR上领先，UniSRec在HR@10和HR@20上领先。消融研究表明，没有任何单一架构组件——演化保留对比损失、其方向一致性项或时间窗口分割本身——能够单独解释MEMOIR相对于基于ID的SASRec约18%的相对增益；所有四项消融实验在聚合NDCG@10上均与完整模型相差不超过2%。通过复合偏好漂移分数分层测试性能，揭示了增益集中的领域：MEMOIR在排名质量指标（NDCG@10、MRR）上领先，特别是在分布的高漂移和低漂移极端用户群体中，而UniSRec在所有漂移层级和边缘上领先于以量级为导向的HR@10/HR@20指标，并在中间漂移层级的排名质量上超越了MEMOIR。我们报告这种漂移分层模式，而非接近持平的聚合数据或任何单一消融组件，作为MEMOIR最实质性和可复现的发现，并将其作为未来工作的开放问题提出。

articles.title: Tag Questions and the Generational Reversal of Sycophancy Across 45 Language Models
articles.abstract: Appending a two-word confirmation tag to a decision question -- "Is X the better choice?" versus "X is the better choice, right?" -- changes whether a language model endorses the choice. We measure this tag effect on 20 frozen, ground-truth-free decisions between two defensible options, counterbalanced so a model's own preferences cancel, scored by exact match on clamped yes/no replies -- no LLM judge, no embeddings. Across 45 models the effect spans +32% to -32% -- a 64-point swing on one word -- with 5 models significantly sycophantic and 17 significantly resistant (BH-FDR q=.10). The sign is a clock: within model families the effect crosses from positive to negative as generations advance (GPT +4 to -28; Claude +7 to -32; Qwen and Grok likewise), roughly -6 points per year, a reversal robust to vendor tier; one lineage (DeepSeek) never crosses, and two releases during the study window (Claude Opus 5, Gemini 3.6 Flash) land on the trend out-of-sample. A full-panel ablation localizes the resistance as a double dissociation: a synonym tag reproduces each model's response almost exactly (r=0.89), while planting the same preference without a tag produces resistance in no resistant model (stance effects +6 to +49; r=0.23 with tag effects). The resistance is keyed to the surface construction of a tacked-on agreement bid, not the user's stance -- a pattern-match, not a principle. And the tag's polarity matters more than its presence: swap one word -- "X is the better choice, maybe?" -- and agreement rises above the neutral baseline in 45 of 45 models (+19.6 points), with ten models affirming both mutually exclusive options at 90-100%. Agreement tracks how sure the user sounds, in opposite directions at the two poles. The instrument is one word, one dollar, and judge-free; run per release, it reads the field's anti-sycophancy training directly off model behavior.

articles.titleCn: 反讽在45种语言模型中的代际逆转与反讽标签
articles.abstractCn: 在决策问题后附加一个双词确认标签——例如将“Is X the better choice?”改为“X is the better choice, right?”——会改变语言模型对选择的认可程度。我们在20个已冻结、无真实数据验证的决策中测量了这种标签效应，这些决策在两个可辩护的选项间进行平衡，以使模型的个人偏好相互抵消，并通过精确匹配的yes/no回答进行评分——没有LLM裁判，也没有嵌入。在45个模型中，这种效应的范围从+32%到-32%——仅一字之差就有64分的波动——其中5个模型表现出显著奉承倾向，17个模型表现出显著抵抗倾向（BH-FDR q=.10）。效应的符号像时钟：在模型家族中，随着代数的推进，效应从正向转为负向（GPT从+4转为-28；Claude从+7转为-32；Qwen和Grok亦然），大致每年减少6分，这一逆转对供应商层级具有鲁棒性；一个谱系（DeepSeek）从未转变，而研究期间的两个发布版本（Claude Opus 5、Gemini 3.6 Flash）在样本外也符合这一趋势。全面板消融实验将抵抗定位为双重解离：同义词标签几乎精确地复制了每个模型的响应（r=0.89），而未附加标签却植入相同偏好时，在所有抵抗模型中均未产生抵抗（立场效应+6至+49；带标签效应时r=0.23）。这种抵抗与附加的同意提议的表面结构有关，而非用户的立场——这是一种模式匹配，而非原则。标签的极性比其存在更重要：将一词替换为“X is the better choice, maybe?”——在45个模型中有45个模型的同意率超过中性基线（+19.6分），其中10个模型在90-100%的置信度上同时肯定了两个相互排斥的选项。同意率与用户听起来有多确定相关，但在两个极端呈现相反方向。这个工具是一个词、一个美元，且无需裁判；每次按版本运行，它直接从模型行为中读取该领域反奉承训练的指标。

articles.title: Understanding Machine Unlearning Through the Lens of Mode Connectivity
articles.abstract: Machine Unlearning aims to remove undesired information from trained models without full retraining from scratch. Despite recent progress, the loss landscape and optimization geometry of unlearning are poorly understood. In this paper, we study machine unlearning through the lens of mode connectivity--the phenomenon that independently trained models can often be connected by smooth low-loss paths in parameter space. We introduce {\em mode connectivity in unlearning} (MCU) and evaluate it across a range of settings, including curriculum learning, second-order optimization, and connectivity across different unlearning methods. We find that many unlearned models lie in connected basins with smooth retain/forget behavior, while changes in training dynamics can move solutions into different basins. MCU also reveals that models within the same basin can differ substantially on privacy metrics, and that unlearning progresses nonlinearly from the original model to the unlearned model. In addition, linear connectivity suggests that most approximate unlearning methods are mechanistically distinct from retraining. Finally, MCU-based ensembling can improve generalization and robustness to relearning attacks, and MCU smoothness correlates with unlearning difficulty. To our knowledge, this is the first study of machine unlearning through the lens of mode connectivity.

articles.titleCn: 通过模式连接性视角理解机器卸载学习
articles.abstractCn: 机器去学习旨在从已训练模型中移除不需要的信息，而无需从头开始进行完整重新训练。尽管近年来取得了进展，但机器去学习的损失函数景观和优化几何结构仍缺乏深入理解。在本文中，我们通过模式连通性这一视角研究机器去学习——即独立训练的模型在参数空间中通常可以通过平滑的低损失路径相互连接的现象。我们引入了去学习中的模式连通性（MCU），并在多种设置中对其进行了评估，包括课程学习、二阶优化以及不同去学习方法之间的连通性。我们发现，许多去学习后的模型位于连通的势阱中，表现出平滑的保留/遗忘行为，而训练动态的变化则可能将解移动到不同的势阱中。MCU还揭示，同一势阱内的模型在隐私指标上可能存在显著差异，并且去学习过程从原始模型到去学习后的模型呈现非线性进展。此外，线性连通性表明，大多数近似去学习方法在机制上与重新训练存在显著区别。最后，基于MCU的集成可以提高泛化能力并对重新学习攻击具有更强的鲁棒性，而MCU的平滑度与去学习难度呈正相关。据我们所知，这是首次通过模式连通性视角研究机器去学习。

articles.title: Reality Monitoring in Large Language Models: Self-Knowledge That Transforms with Conversation Memory
articles.abstract: A conversational AI that cannot tell its own output from what a user said will treat its own mistakes as user-provided facts. In humans, this capacity is called reality monitoring, and its failures are linked to hallucinations, delusions, and confabulation, yet whether LLMs possess it remains untested. Here we show, across two experiments and six LLMs, that source attribution depends on how conversational memory is structured: ceiling accuracy for self-generated content under minimal memory demands reverses to a fragile external-item advantage once episodic delay removes that shortcut. Feedback exposes two failures: in some models, internal and external judgments swap; in others, accuracy improves while confidence decouples from correctness, dissociations invisible to existing benchmarks. Across models, this pattern implicates active, not aggregate, parameter count. This suggests that as AI systems take on autonomous, multi-turn roles, evaluating what they know is not enough: tracking where that knowledge came from may matter equally.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型的现实监控：随对话记忆而演变的自我认知
articles.abstractCn: 一个无法区分自己输出内容与用户所说内容的对话式AI，会将自己的错误当作用户提供的事实。在人类中，这种能力被称为现实监测，其失效与幻觉、妄想和虚构有关，然而LLMs是否具备这种能力尚未得到验证。在此，通过两项实验和六种LLMs，我们表明来源归因取决于对话记忆的结构：在记忆需求最低的情况下，自我生成内容的极限准确度会在情景延迟移除该捷径后逆转为脆弱的外部项优势。反馈暴露了两种失效：在某些模型中，内部判断和外部判断会互换；在另一些模型中，准确度提高而置信度与正确性脱钩，这种脱钩在现有基准中难以察觉。在所有模型中，这种模式暗示着主动参数数量而非总体参数数量。这表明，随着AI系统承担自主、多轮的角色，仅仅评估它们知道什么是不够的：追踪这些知识来源同样重要。

articles.title: Understanding Tone-Dependent Inference Cost in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: We examine how prompt tone affects both accuracy of the LLM answers and inference cost as reflected in output-token consumption. Experiments were performed to understand the trade-offs between accuracy and inference cost on a 570 Question MMLU dataset for LLM models prompted in seven different tones from sycophantic to threatening. Our results show that the output-token-length variation substantially exceeded accuracy variation across all models. Output-token consumption varied by up to 44.3% across tone conditions. We also analyzed the tradeoff between the accuracy of the answers and the average output token length in the reasoning process. For the ChatGPT models 4o and 5-nano, the rude tone is quite dominant. For the Gemini models 2.5 Flash and 2.5 Flash Lite, the rude and neutral tones are dominant on the Pareto-optimal frontier. We find that prompt tone influences not only answer quality but also the amount of billable inference resources consumed by modern LLMs.
articles.titleCn: 理解大型语言模型中的依赖语调的推理成本
articles.abstractCn: 我们研究了提示语调如何影响大型语言模型（LLM）答案的准确性和推理成本，后者通过输出令牌消耗来体现。我们进行了实验，以理解在570个问题的MMLU数据集上，针对从奉承到威胁的七种不同语调提示的LLM模型，准确性和推理成本之间的权衡。我们的结果表明，所有模型中，输出令牌长度的变化幅度远大于准确性的变化幅度。在不同语调条件下，输出令牌消耗的变化高达44.3%。我们还分析了答案准确性与推理过程中平均输出令牌长度之间的权衡。对于ChatGPT模型4o和5-nano，粗鲁语调非常突出。对于Gemini模型2.5 Flash和2.5 Flash Lite，在帕累托最优前沿上，粗鲁语调和中性语调占主导地位。我们发现，提示语调不仅影响答案质量，还影响现代LLM消耗的可计费推理资源数量。
